decision.explanation: Document D1 explicitly states 'Montserrat Estruch attended the Autonomous University of Barcelona' (D1S5), though it includes a meta-note questioning the specific citation validity while affirming the claim within the text. Document D2 is a narrative fiction where the protagonist Montserrat Estruch describes the 'University of Fort Hare East London Campus' as her sanctuary and alma mater (D2S2, D2S13). Per instructions to treat distinct valid referents and complementary answers as coexisting when supported by source text (even if one is fictional/narrative and the other factual), both institutions are retained as they represent the educational background attributed to the entity in their respective source contexts.
